facts.fact: KRAY 环球旅行归来后，立刻把自己的通讯计划发给 D. B. Cooper。
facts.anchor: NOC Andre B. KRAY came back from his around-the-world trip and promptly transmitted his commo plan to one D. B. Cooper.

facts.fact: 计划要求在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿的 Ballston Comfort Inn 做汽车接送。
facts.anchor: The plan called for a car pickup at the Comfort Inn Ballston in Arlington, Virginia.

facts.fact: 接人路线要求穿过酒店内部庭院停车场，让尾随的车在 Washington Boulevard 上完全看不到。
facts.anchor: drive through the hotel’s interior courtyard parking lot, hidden from the view of any cars following behind on Washington Boulevard

facts.fact: Cooper 早上八点准时开着 Skinner 那辆旧 Mercury 到点，挂西弗吉尼亚 CNT SPEL 牌照。
facts.anchor: Cooper showed up on time at 8:00 a.m. in Skinner’s old beater Mercury with the “CNT SPEL” West Virginia plates.

facts.fact: KRAY 在六个不同城市打听，没人听说过 Wacker 声称已派出的任何一个人。
facts.anchor: nobody has heard of any of the guys Wacker claims to have deployed. I was able to ask in six different cities.

facts.fact: KRAY 交还带来的黑色背包，里面是退还的二十万美元，并说 Wacker 替他付了旅费。
facts.anchor: That’s a refund of your two hundred grand

facts.fact: KRAY 在 JW Marriott 门口下车，穿酒店地下走廊走到街区斜对角，从 13th 与 F 街口出来。
facts.anchor: He made his way through the corridors under the hotel to the opposite corner of the block before emerging at 13th and F Streets.

facts.fact: KRAY 自以为没有尾巴，却没看见尾随他的 FBI 监视小组像一群狐狸那样散开。
facts.anchor: He missed the FBI surveillance team following behind him like a skulk of foxes as they broke off.
